title: Social Club Attendance Feed Freshness Gap
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=club:attendance
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by venue
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects stale check-in or attendance feeds for social club attendance before a whole week of activity disappears.
value: Personal community reporting only works when the check-ins keep flowing, so freshness monitoring protects every downstream chart.
implementation: Use a consistent location or source identifier for each check-in path or import job.
visualization: Table of sources or locations by hours since the last event.
grandmaExplanation: It builds when the data stream for social club attendance has stopped updating.
